messages.subject: For Daniel Hajj | Latin America telecom, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear America Movil Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Daniel Hajj Aboumrad, Chief Executive Officer.

America Movil's scale across Latin America places government relations, regulation, digital infrastructure and institutional partnerships at the center of long-term execution. That environment aligns closely with my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, regional stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support America Movil's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to America Movil.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
